---
title: "People"
page-layout: full
title-block-banner: true
---

Researchers, students, public health professionals, and decision-makers from
across the region working on infectious disease modelling.

::: {.callout-note}
This directory is starting out empty (a `people.csv` placeholder row is
included so the format is clear). We plan to import the full list from the
existing Google Form/Sheet — see `EDITING.md` for how to swap it in.
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
people = FileAttachment("people.csv").csv({typed: false})

html`<div class="people-grid">
  ${people.map(p => html`
    <div class="person-card">
      <img src="${p.photo && p.photo.trim() ? p.photo : '/images/people/placeholder-avatar.svg'}" alt="${p.name}">
      <div class="person-card-body">
        <h3>${p.profile_url && p.profile_url.trim()
          ? html`<a href="${p.profile_url}">${p.name}</a>`
          : p.name}</h3>
        <p class="person-title">${p.title}</p>
        <p class="person-institution">${p.institution}</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  `)}
</div>`
```

<style>
.people-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr));
  gap: 1.5rem;
  margin-top: 1rem;
}
.person-card {
  border: 1px solid #e5e0ea;
  border-radius: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-align: center;
}
.person-card img {
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
  object-fit: cover;
}
.person-card-body {
  padding: 0.75rem;
}
.person-card-body h3 {
  font-size: 1rem;
  margin: 0 0 0.25rem 0;
}
.person-title, .person-institution {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: #555;
  margin: 0;
}
</style>
